strands.name: Number & Quantity
strands.summary: From fractions and decimals to the real and complex number systems: what numbers are, how they compare, and how exponents and radicals extend them.

strands.name: Expressions & Equations
strands.summary: Writing, rearranging and solving: from one-step equations to systems, polynomial roots and series.

strands.name: Geometry & Trigonometry
strands.summary: Shape, measurement and transformation, growing into right-triangle and circular trigonometry, identities and vectors.

strands.name: Functions & Modeling
strands.summary: The idea of a function and its families — linear, exponential, quadratic, polynomial, rational, logarithmic — used to model the world.

strands.name: Data, Statistics & Probability
strands.summary: Collecting, displaying and reasoning from data under uncertainty, from bar graphs to inference.

strands.name: Rate of Change & Accumulation
strands.summary: How quantities change and add up: unit rate, then slope, then the derivative and the integral.

strands.name: Mathematical Practices
strands.summary: Habits assessed all year rather than in one unit: reasoning, communication, perseverance, tools.

flags.text: Rational functions have no home in the standard track. They were IM3 Unit 3; the new Unit 3 is polynomials. Adv Precalc and Precalc cover them. Deliberate handoff or accidental drop?
Optimization was dropped from IM3 (old Unit 9) and nothing below Calculus picks it up.
IM3 Unit 4, "Polynomial Identities and Proofs", has no proficiencies yet.
Fractional exponents and radicals moved down to IM1, but IM2 Unit 5 is still "Rational Exponents and Radicals".
Logarithms were removed from IM2, so IM3 Unit 2 is now students’ first exposure rather than their second. Confirm this is intentional.
IM2 is still a list of unit titles. It needs skill statements like IM1 and IM3.
IM3 Unit 8 statement is truncated: “…whether the transformation is described in geometric notation” — presumably “…or in function notation.”
Ntigrams are specific to Fathom software; Desmos and Sheets cannot draw them.
